name: gardener's notebook
description: a water-damaged gardener's notebook. the last entry: 'october 30th — strange lights in the study again tonight. the missus says it is nothing, but i have worked here 20 years. i know what i saw. the skull. i found a sketch of it in the master's private papers. and i found where it goes — the altar in the crypt below the graveyard. tomorrow i am leaving. i do not care if they dock my pay.' the notebook ends there.
